component.title: Sortable
component.purpose: Make reordering direct, keyboard-complete, persisted, and recoverable without visual seams.

states.description: A reorderable list exposes pointer and keyboard handles.
A new order is visible immediately while persistence is pending.
A failed write restores the previous order and announces recovery.

claims.statement: Every pointer reorder has a keyboard pickup, Arrow movement, Enter commit, and Escape cancellation path.
The rendered order updates immediately and returns to the prior order when persistence rejects.
Non-dragged rows animate keyed displacement through AutoAnimateLayout, while reduced motion settles directly.
